proc stdSync(home = carneHome(); base = stdJsRepoBase): tuple[

    ...raises: [OSError, IOError, IOError, KeyError, IOError], tags: [ExecIOEffect,
    ReadIOEffect, RootEffect, WriteIOEffect, WriteDirEffect, ReadDirEffect],
    forbids: [].}
carne std init / update: resolves the ref, fetches the remote manifest, then downloads only missing or changed files (verified before each write). Writes the local manifest copy last. upToDate is true when the local version already matched and nothing was downloaded. Raises IOError on failure.
